$comment: All user-facing modal and notification text lives here. To translate the app, copy this file to <language-code>.json (e.g. es.json, fr.json) in the same folder, translate the values, and it will be picked up automatically. Keep the {placeholders} intact. The active language is read from the 'locale' key in localStorage and falls back to 'en'.

networkCreatedNoPassword.title: Network Created Without Password
networkCreatedNoPassword.description: The secured network couldn't be started, so it was created as an open network with no password. Anyone nearby can connect to it.

joinAttemptsPaused.title: Join Attempts Paused
joinAttemptsPaused.description: Too many incorrect codes were entered from different devices — someone may be guessing your code. New joins are paused for {seconds} seconds.

displaySettingsUnavailable.title: Unable to Open Display Settings
displaySettingsUnavailable.description: Please adjust your display settings manually.

disconnectTimeout.title: Disconnect Timeout Updated
disconnectTimeout.immediate: Displays of disconnected devices will now be removed immediately.
disconnectTimeout.delayed: Disconnected devices now have {seconds} {unit} to reconnect before their display is removed.
disconnectTimeout.failureDescription: The timeout couldn't be applied. The previous value is still in use.

turn.savedDescription: Devices on other networks will now relay through this TURN server. It applies on the next connection.
turn.clearedDescription: No TURN server is configured. Connections across different networks may fail.
turn.failureDescription: The relay settings couldn't be saved. The previous settings are still in use.

publicSessions.enabledDescription: Devices on other networks can now join over the internet using your session link on the Add Device screen.
publicSessions.disabledDescription: The "Anywhere (Internet)" option is now hidden and this host is no longer reachable through session.screenextend.app.
publicSessions.failureDescription: The public session setting couldn't be applied. It is unchanged.

gpuEncoding.disabledDescription: Video is now encoded on the CPU (software). This uses far more CPU and can lower quality or frame rate. Connected devices reconnect using the software encoder.
gpuEncoding.enabledDescription: Video is encoded on the GPU again when hardware is available. Connected devices reconnect with the updated encoder.
gpuEncoding.failureDescription: The encoder setting couldn't be applied. The previous encoder is still in use.

autostart.enabledDescription: ScreenExtend will now open automatically when you sign in to your computer.
autostart.disabledDescription: ScreenExtend will no longer open automatically when you sign in.
autostart.failureDescription: The startup setting couldn't be changed. Please try again.

invalidPorts.title: Invalid Ports
invalidPorts.description: Enter two different port numbers between 1 and 65535 for HTTP and HTTPS.

serverPorts.title: Server Ports Updated
serverPorts.description: Local network streaming now uses HTTP port {http} and HTTPS port {https}. Connected devices were disconnected and must rejoin using the updated links.
serverPorts.failureDescription: The ports couldn't be changed — another program may already be using them. The previous ports are still in use.

networkCreate.successDescription: The hosted network has successfully been created. Connect other devices to the "{name}" Wifi network.
networkCreate.failureDescription: There was an error in creating the hosted network. Try the action again and ensure no other app is using the Wifi-Direct card, such as hotspot.

networkStop.title: Network Stop Success
networkStop.description: The hosted network has successfully been stopped. All devices have been disconnected.
networkStop.failureDescription: The hosted network may still be running. Try again, or turn off the hotspot from Windows settings.

networkSettings.successDescription: The network settings have successfully been updated.
networkSettings.failureDescription: There was an error in updating the network settings.

avatar.saveFailedDescription: There was a problem writing your profile picture to disk. Please try again.
avatar.updatedDescription: Your new profile picture has been saved.
avatar.removeFailedDescription: There was a problem removing your profile picture. Please try again.
avatar.removedDescription: Your profile picture has been reset to the default.
avatar.loadFailedDescription: That image couldn’t be read. Try a different file, or convert it to JPEG or PNG first.

account.updateFailedDescription: Your name couldn't be saved. Please try again.

wifi.turnOnFailedDescription: Please enable Wi-Fi manually from Windows settings, then try again.

device.updatedDescription: Your device settings have successfully been updated.
device.removedDescription: Your device has been successfully removed.
device.removeFailedDescription: This device couldn't be removed. It may still be able to join. Please try again.
device.refreshedDescription: {name} is reconnecting its video stream. Its extended display stays where it is.
device.refreshOfflineDescription: {name} has no live stream right now. It will get a fresh one when it reconnects.
device.refreshFailedDescription: The stream couldn't be restarted. The current connection is unchanged. Please try again.

deviceBan.bannedDescription: {ip} has been disconnected and blocked from joining again.
deviceBan.invalidDescription: Enter a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address to ban.
deviceBan.failureDescription: The ban list couldn't be changed, so this device's access is unchanged. Please try again.

configEditor.loadFailedDescription: The configuration file couldn't be read, so the editor can't be opened. Reopen this page to try again.
configEditor.copyFailedDescription: ScreenExtend couldn't write to the clipboard. Select the text in the editor and copy it manually.
configEditor.refreshFailedTitle: Saved, but the Page Didn't Refresh
configEditor.refreshFailedDescription: Your configuration was applied, but this page couldn't reload it. Reopen Settings to see the current values.
configEditor.applyFailedDescription: The configuration could not be applied to the running host. Your saved settings were not changed. See the problem list below for details.

config.saveFailedDescription: Your change couldn't be written to disk and may be lost when ScreenExtend closes. Please try again.
config.flushFailedDescription: The change is active for this session but couldn't be written to disk, so it may not survive a restart.

settings.loadFailedDescription: Some settings couldn't be read and may show default values. Reopen this page to try again.
settings.saveFailedDescription: Your change couldn't be saved. Please try again.

deviceApprove.failureDescription: This device is connected, but it wasn't saved as trusted and will need the join code again next time.

volumeKeyProxy.failureDescription: The volume key setting couldn't be applied to the audio driver. Your media keys behave as they did before.

sessionCredentials.failureDescription: The host didn't accept the new session ID and join code, so the code on screen won't work. Restart ScreenExtend to try again.

eventBridge.failureDescription: ScreenExtend can't receive updates from the host, so devices and status may not refresh. Restart the app to restore live updates.

qrRefresh.failureDescription: The join links and QR codes may be out of date. Reopen the Add Device screen to refresh them.

cloudSession.failureDescription: Devices on other networks may not be able to join. Local network joining still works.

cloudStatus.unavailableDescription: ScreenExtend can't read the public session status, so the indicator may be out of date.

knownDevices.loadFailedDescription: The list of past devices may be out of date. Reopen this page to refresh it.

permissions.checkFailedDescription: ScreenExtend couldn't read the current permission status. Try again, or restart the app.

driverInstall.failureDescription: Driver installation didn't complete — it needs administrator approval. Try again and accept the prompt.

uninstallDrivers.failureDescription: Driver removal didn't complete — it needs administrator approval. ScreenExtend stayed open so you can try again.

exitApp.failureDescription: The app couldn't shut down cleanly. Close it from your taskbar or Dock.

relaunch.failureDescription: The app couldn't restart itself. Close it and open it again manually.

resetPreferences.successDescription: Dialog and reminder preferences have been restored to their defaults.
resetPreferences.failureDescription: Your preferences couldn't be reset. Please try again.

replayTour.failureDescription: The walkthrough couldn't be started. Please try again.

walkthrough.failureDescription: The walkthrough may appear again next time you open ScreenExtend.

theme.failureDescription: The theme couldn't be saved and may revert the next time you open ScreenExtend.

zoom.failureDescription: The zoom level couldn't be applied. Please try again.

clipboard.copyFailedDescription: ScreenExtend couldn't write to the clipboard. Select the text and copy it manually.

openLink.failureDescription: No browser could be opened for this link. Copy the address and open it manually.

logs.backlogFailedDescription: Earlier log lines couldn't be read. New lines will still appear as they arrive.
logs.streamFailedDescription: New log lines won't appear here. Reopen this page to reconnect.

compatibility.saveFailedDescription: This compatibility notice may appear again the next time you open ScreenExtend.

refreshStream.label: Refresh stream
refreshStream.tip: Restarts this device's video stream without disturbing its extended display or making it rejoin.

systemAudio.label: System Audio
systemAudio.tip: Streams this computer's audio output to the device.
systemAudio.unsupported: System audio streaming isn't available on this host's operating system version (needs macOS 10.15 or later, or Windows 10 20H1 or later).
systemAudio.needsInstall: System audio on this macOS version needs a one-time audio component install. Turning this on will guide you through it.
systemAudio.active: System audio is active via the ScreenExtend Audio device on this macOS version.
systemAudio.installBody: This macOS version has no built-in way to capture system audio, so ScreenExtend installs a small audio component. There's one admin prompt. While a device is streaming, ScreenExtend becomes your Mac's output device and restores your previous device automatically afterwards. Your volume keys keep working, and local volume is independent of the connected device's volume.
systemAudio.installedBody: ScreenExtend Audio is installed. System audio is now available.
systemAudio.installFailedBody: The audio component could not be installed. You can retry from the audio toggle.
systemAudio.needsRebootBody: The audio component is installed but needs a restart to finish enabling. Restart your Mac, then turn system audio on again.
systemAudio.uninstalledBody: ScreenExtend Audio was removed and your default output device restored.
systemAudio.checkFailed: System audio support couldn’t be checked. Reopen this device to try again.

volumeKeyProxy.label: Proxy Volume Keys
volumeKeyProxy.tip: While ScreenExtend Audio is your Mac's output device, send the hardware volume and mute keys straight to it. Enable this only if the volume keys stop responding while streaming.

audioOutput.label: Audio Output
audioOutput.tip: Choose which of this device's speakers plays the streamed audio.
audioOutput.speaker: Speaker
audioOutput.waiting: Waiting for this device to report its speakers…
audioOutput.unsupported: This device's browser can't switch speakers; audio plays on its default output.

editNetwork.title: Change network settings?
editNetwork.description: This action will cause devices on the network to be disconnected. They will need to rejoin the network with the new name and/or password.

turnOnWifi.title: Turn on Wi-Fi?
turnOnWifi.description: Hosting a network requires Wi-Fi to be turned on.

wifiQr.title: Join "{name}"
wifiQr.description: Scan this code to connect to the Wi-Fi network.

editDeviceUnsaved.title: Edit Device
editDeviceUnsaved.description: You have unsaved changes. Clicking continue will discard your edits.

removeDevice.title: Remove Device
removeDevice.description: This action cannot be undone. The device will immediately disconnect but can reconnect for future sessions.

avatarCrop.title: Adjust your profile picture
avatarCrop.description: Drag to reposition and use the slider to zoom.

configEditorUnsaved.title: Unsaved configuration
configEditorUnsaved.description: You have unsaved changes in the config editor. Clicking continue will discard your edits.

update.title: Downloading Update
update.versionNote: A new version ({version}) of ScreenExtend is being downloaded and installed.
update.restartNote: The app will restart automatically once the update is ready. Please don't close it.

updateFailed.title: Update Failed
updateFailed.bodyBeforeLink: The latest update couldn't be downloaded or installed. You can get the newest version manually from
updateFailed.bodyAfterLink: . You can also continue with your current version for now.

setupError.title: Setup Error
setupError.bodyBeforePrompt: There was an error while attempting to start ScreenExtend. This often occurs due to core drivers or libraries not being installed.
setupError.installPrompt: Click the button below to install the missing components.
setupError.bodyAfterPrompt: If this error is recurring, contact support at

compatibility.blockingIntro: ScreenExtend cannot run because the following required platform APIs are unavailable on this system:
compatibility.limitedIntro: The following platform APIs are unavailable. ScreenExtend can continue, but these features will be limited or non-functional:
compatibility.upgradeBefore: Please upgrade your operating system or contact support at

permissions.title: Permissions Required
permissions.body: ScreenExtend needs the permissions below before it can create a display and stream to your devices. Grant each one and this window continues on its own — no need to come back and press anything.
permissions.tipBody: macOS may need ScreenExtend to restart before a newly granted permission takes effect. Use Restart if a permission still shows as missing.

conflict.title: Configuration changed since you started editing
conflict.description: Settings were changed elsewhere in the app while this document had unsaved edits. Compare the two below, then choose which one to keep.
